scope: Corollary 11.9 (Strict rational budget) of the manuscript “Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions” (preprints/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 066 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d50937326c7cb115), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 69. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On the same geometric generic fibre, one can choose positive rational numbers αi arbitrarily close to κ/bi, a finite list of additional actual angular functions Uj, and arbitrarily small positive rational ej, so that every prime divisor P over a proper model satisfies (11.5) Aθw,rel (P) > min i active αiP(Fi) + X j ej min{0, P(Uj)}. The same zero-entry convention applies to an active cap. The list may include field generators over k′. The added ej-weighted terms and the errors from approximating κ/bi may meet any prescribed finite degree, value and Lipschitz tolerances along a specified local affine optimizer continuation.
